t: What to say after a bad dream
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
p: Aʿūdhu bi-kalimāti-Llāhi-t-tāmmati min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābihi wa sharri ʿibādihi, wa min hamazāti-sh-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn
m: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the promptings of the devils and that they should be present with me.
